item.title: Philly City Council moves to regulate windshield barnacles after court blocks police enforcement
item.description: The renewed focus follows a court injunction that halted a police directive treating barnacles used on private property the same as towing across the city.

item.description: The private memorial service at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition's headquarters on the South Side of Chicago will include only a few hundred attendees, who are expected to be mostly family members, allies and confidants.

item.title: Philadelphia Robotics Coalition helps build communication skills for local students
item.description: The Philadelphia Robotics Coalition gathered students for a special day of innovation.

item.title: 90-year-old Ocean City man tallies 10,000 beach days
item.description: After his wife passed away, Earl Paul found healing on the shores of Ocean City. At 90 years old, he still visits the beach daily.

item.title: Pedestrian killed after hit‑and‑run crash in Chester Heights, Delaware County
item.description: Pennsylvania State Police are investigating a fatal hit‑and‑run crash that occurred late Thursday night in Chester Heights, Delaware County.

item.title: Trump grieves with families during return of soldiers killed in war in the Middle East
item.description: President Donald Trump joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base for the dignified transfer of six U.S. Army Reserve soldiers killed in Kuwait.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.

item.title: Mother of 'Abbott Elementary' inspiration celebrates 104th birthday
item.description: BROOMALL, Pa. (WPVI) - Rosa Lee Stephens marked her 104th birthday surrounded by cheers, applause and generations of family, a celebration that reflected what she says has mattered most throughout her life: faith, community and loved ones.

item.title: Family urges hit‑and‑run driver to come forward after father of 3 killed in Chester Heights
item.description: CHESTER HEIGHTS, Pa. - The family of 57‑year‑old Steven Hulsey of Upper Darby is pleading for answers after he was struck and killed by a hit‑and‑run driver late Friday night.
